projects.title: Play on the Highway
projects.description:
We were very excited when Coca-Cola Bottling Albania selected our design to turn it into a giant mural covering the entire front wall and side parts of their headquarters in Tirana. 

With a fascinating design inspired by the artistic movement POP-ART, a genre known for its bold images, which often used Coca-Cola as a visual element.

In creating these murals, we combined our creative side with years of experience to produce a work of art featuring a vibrant and dynamic color palette—an attractive facade radiating positivity.
